title: Game of the Rows
statementMd:
Daenerys Targaryen has an army consisting of $*k*$ groups of soldiers, the $*i*$-th group contains $*a*_{*i*}$ soldiers. She wants to bring her army to the other side of the sea to get the Iron Throne. She has recently bought an airplane to carry her army through the sea. The airplane has $*n*$ rows, each of them has $8$ seats. We call two seats neighbor, if they are in the same row and in seats ${1, 2}$, ${3, 4}$, ${4, 5}$, ${5, 6}$ or ${7, 8}$.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/94c2003aac63472c659ddd90cea0da9273e7920b.png) A row in the airplane

Daenerys Targaryen wants to place her army in the plane so that there are no two soldiers from different groups sitting on neighboring seats.

Your task is to determine if there is a possible arranging of her army in the airplane such that the condition above is satisfied.

## Input

The first line contains two integers $*n*$ and $*k*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10000$, $1 ≤ *k* ≤ 100$) — the number of rows and the number of groups of soldiers, respectively.

The second line contains $*k*$ integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, *a*_{3}, ..., *a*_{*k*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10000$), where $*a*_{*i*}$ denotes the number of soldiers in the $*i*$-th group.

It is guaranteed that $*a*_{1} + *a*_{2} + ... + *a*_{*k*} ≤ 8·*n*$.

## Output

If we can place the soldiers in the airplane print "`YES`" (without quotes). Otherwise print "`NO`" (without quotes).

You can choose the case (lower or upper) for each letter arbitrary.

## Note

In the first sample, Daenerys can place the soldiers like in the figure below:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2b47e4bc244b20e830dac445313e2fc38187114d.png)

In the second sample, there is no way to place the soldiers in the plane since the second group soldier will always have a seat neighboring to someone from the first group.

In the third example Daenerys can place the first group on seats $(1, 2, 7, 8)$, and the second group an all the remaining seats.

In the fourth example she can place the first two groups on seats $(1, 2)$ and $(7, 8)$, the third group on seats $(3)$, and the fourth group on seats $(5, 6)$.
statementZhMd:
丹妮莉丝·坦格利安拥有一支由 $*k*$ 个小组组成的军队，第 $*i*$ 个小组包含 $*a*_{*i*}$ 名士兵。她想把军队带到海的另一边，以夺取铁王座。她最近买了一架飞机，用来运送军队渡海。这架飞机有 $*n*$ 排座位，每排有 $8$ 个座位。如果两个座位位于同一排，且座位编号属于 ${1, 2}$、${3, 4}$、${4, 5}$、${5, 6}$ 或 ${7, 8}$，则称这两个座位相邻。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/94c2003aac63472c659ddd90cea0da9273e7920b.png) 飞机中的一排座位

丹妮莉丝·坦格利安希望将她的军队安排在飞机上，使得不存在来自不同小组的两名士兵坐在相邻座位上。

你的任务是判断是否存在一种安排方式，使上述条件得到满足。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*k*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10000$，$1 ≤ *k* ≤ 100$）——分别表示座位排数和士兵小组数。

第二行包含 $*k*$ 个整数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, *a*_{3}, ..., *a*_{*k*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10000$），其中 $*a*_{*i*}$ 表示第 $*i*$ 个小组中的士兵人数。

保证 $*a*_{1} + *a*_{2} + ... + *a*_{*k*} ≤ 8·*n*$。

## 输出格式

如果可以将士兵安排在飞机上，输出“`YES`”（不含引号）；否则输出“`NO`”（不含引号）。

每个字母的大小写可以任意选择。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，丹妮莉丝可以按照下图安排士兵：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2b47e4bc244b20e830dac445313e2fc38187114d.png)

在第二个样例中，无法将士兵安排在飞机上，因为第二组士兵总会有一个座位与第一组的某名士兵相邻。

在第三个样例中，丹妮莉丝可以将第一组安排在座位 $(1, 2, 7, 8)$ 上，将第二组安排在所有剩余座位上。

在第四个样例中，她可以将前两个小组分别安排在座位 $(1, 2)$ 和 $(7, 8)$ 上，将第三组安排在座位 $(3)$ 上，将第四组安排在座位 $(5, 6)$ 上。
